# nhi-pas-fhir

> Open-source, validator-clean **FHIR R4 reference implementation** for **Taiwan NHI Prior
> Authorization (健保署 事前審查 / TWPAS)**, plus a faithful **CQL** pre-submit rule check. It turns a
> plain description of a case into the exact FHIR `Bundle` the NHI expects, guarantees it passes the
> official HL7 validator at **0 errors**, and can run the NHI's own published CQL rules to predict
> **核刪 (clawback)** before you submit. C# (Firely SDK) primary; Python reference.

## Canonical facts (do not fabricate around these)

- Domain source of truth: https://nhicore.nhi.gov.tw/pas/
- IG: `tw.gov.mohw.nhi.pas#1.2.6`, FHIR R4 (4.0.1). Inherits `tw.gov.mohw.twcore` +
  `hl7.fhir.us.davinci-pas`. CQL rules IG: `tw.gov.mohw.nhi.cql` (draft, ~66 drug rules as ELM).
- Correctness is machine-proven: the official HL7 FHIR validator at 0 errors (structural + terminology),
  never asserted. No real patient data — all identifiers fabricated.
- 43/43 instantiable IG profiles exercised; all 50 NHI departments + filing/application categories
  parameterized.

## What it is / is not

- IS: a payload factory (assembles the Bundle) + a validator gate + a response handler + an optional
  CQL self-check. You describe the case; the library speaks FHIR.
- IS NOT: a FHIR server (that is the NHI platform's role). Submitting to NHI ("送") is a thin, swappable
  transport adapter; the hard, valuable part is producing the exactly-correct Bundle.

## Key concepts

- Flow: 產 (assemble Bundle) → 驗 (seed drug↔indication check) → 查 (CQL self-check) → 送 (submit) →
  回 (ClaimResponse). 收件 ≠ 核准: acceptance is `queued/審核中`, not approval; 核刪 happens later.
- CQL vs ELM vs engine: CQL = the rule text (like SQL); ELM = compiled rule (like an execution plan);
  the CQL engine = executor (like SQL Server). Faithful engine here = CQF-Ruler / HAPI clinical-reasoning
  (implements InCodeSystem); a lightweight JS engine does not.
- Three-state CQL verdict: Pass / WouldBeRejected (核刪) / DataMissing (補件). Not pass/fail.
- Toggle + socket design: ICqlPreCheck (off by default) → CqlPreCheck → ICqlEngine (CqfRulerCqlEngine);
  IPasSubmitter for 送. Rules live in the server; a rule/IG update = reload + re-run, no code change.

## For AI agents

- `AGENTS.md` — the agent onboarding guide: repo map, copy-paste build/test/run commands, how the
  toggle/socket pieces fit, the non-negotiable rules (never fabricate FHIR; correctness = validator 0
  errors), and the gotchas. Read it first if you are going to build or modify anything here.

## Map

- `spec/` — language-agnostic single source of truth (specs, IG mirror, reference golden bundles).
- `spec/docs/cql-explained.md` — plain-language: what CQL is (16 Q&A).
- `spec/docs/cql-wiring.md` — how CQL is wired into the framework.
- `spec/docs/cql-integration-notes.md` — CQL design + gotchas.
- `spec/docs/IG-TRACEABILITY.md` — every official IG artifact ↔ where the code covers it.
- `impl/csharp/` — primary implementation (Firely SDK). `impl/python/` — reference (pydantic).
- `cql-engine/` — faithful CQL/ELM engine (CQF-Ruler docker + loader + official rules) + a JS runner.
- `demo/` — ASP.NET Core Razor Pages app consuming the lib (產→驗→查→送→回).
- `tools/` — fetch validation assets + validate.sh (official HL7 validator wrapper).

## FAQ (questions people and answer-engines ask)

- What is Taiwan NHI Prior Authorization (事前審查 / TWPAS)? → the 健保署 pre-approval process for
  certain drugs/procedures, expressed as the FHIR R4 IG `tw.gov.mohw.nhi.pas` (on TW Core + Da Vinci PAS).
- How do I build a valid Taiwan NHI PAS FHIR Bundle? → describe the case; the library assembles the
  Bundle and it is checked by the official HL7 validator at 0 errors against the pinned IG.
- What is CQL pre-check / 送前核刪自查? → running the NHI's own published CQL rules (compiled to ELM)
  against your Bundle before submitting, to predict Pass / 核刪 (rejection) / 補件 (missing data).
- Why a CQF-Ruler / HAPI clinical-reasoning server? → faithful CQL needs a full engine implementing
  operators like InCodeSystem; a lightweight JS engine does not. Rules live in the server; updates are a
  reload, not a code change.
- Does submitting mean approval? → No. 收件 ≠ 核准: the receiver accepts (queued / 審核中); the
  adjudication (and 核刪) happens later — which is why the pre-submit self-check exists.
- Is any real patient data used? → No. All identifiers are fabricated; the project never uses real PHI.
